meaning:
ἐμπόριον, -ον, τό
(ἔμπορος) [in LXX: Deu.33:19 (סָפַן), Eze.27:3 (רָכַל); ἐ. εἶναι, Isa.23:17 (זָנָה)* ;]
a trading place, exchange: οἶκος ἐμπορίου, Jhn.2:16.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”
